description: This script processes Valgrind XML output files to generate a CSV report summarizing memory errors detected during testing. It scans a specified directory for XML files, parses each for error types, and writes the results into a CSV file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that creates a CSV report by scanning a directory for Valgrind XML files, parsing them for errors, and writing the results.

methods.name: ParseGtestXml
methods.description: Parses a Valgrind XML file to count different types of memory errors and determine if the test has failed.
